description_en: Queries the details of an access control list (ACL) of an office network or a cloud computer
description_zh: 查询办公网络或云电脑粒度上的公网访问控制策略详情
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-acl-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAV3MpHK1AP0pfERHZN5pu6kRxd1mKkNnHlUy14zdjl/I --office-site-id cn-shanghai+dir-6313240000 --source-type desktop --source-id ecd-22poqua477xo40000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAclEntries

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 1600.

Default value: 1600
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。

最大值：1600。
默认值：1600
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used for the next query. If this parameter is empty, all results have been returned
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The granularity of the ACL.

Valid values:

desktop: cloud computer

vpc: office network
parameters.help_zh: 公网访问控制策略对应的粒度
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the ACL applies. You can specify an office network ID or a cloud computer ID
parameters.help_zh: 公网访问控制对应的实例ID，即办公网络ID或云电脑ID
parameters.name: source_id
